title: apply str() to the password field of URL

labels.name: engine
labels.description: engines, connections, transactions, isolation levels, execution options

body:
### Describe the bug

On the [documents](https://docs.sqlalchemy.org/en/14/core/engines.html?highlight=url#sqlalchemy.engine.URL), it's said that the password attribute may be any object with a `__str__` method. 

While this interface works with psycopg2, it doesn't with asyncpg. Checking `asyncpg.connection.connect`, it requires either a string or a callable that returns a string.

Passing a password object that implements both `__str__` and `__call__` makes it work.

### To Reproduce

```python
import asyncio
from dataclasses import dataclass

from sqlalchemy.ext.asyncio import create_async_engine
from sqlalchemy.engine import URL

@dataclass
class DynamicPassword
    password: str

    def __str__(self) -> str:
        return self.password

async def async_main():
    engine = create_async_engine(
        URL.create(
            drivername="postgresql+asyncpg",
            username="scott",
            password=DynamicPassword(password="tiger"),
            host="localhost",
            port=5432,
            database="test",
        ), echo=True,
    )

    await engine.execute("select 1")
    await engine.dispose()

asyncio.run(async_main())
```
